name: Blood Moon Rising
source:
You hold a secret in your blood that can change the fate of a world you never knew existed. Want to change things for the better? Seduce an alpha to gain their protection and help.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你的血液裡藏著一個秘密，足以改變一個世界的命運，而你原先甚至不知道那個世界存在。想讓事情變得好一些嗎？那就讓一名Alpha為你傾心，爭取對方的保護和幫助。

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
